main_body: Wooden bookshelf frame with three shelf compartments holding books and a plant, drawn straight from the front
top_band: none. At x=8 the column goes from a dark outline (row 10) straight into the back panel of the top compartment (rows 11-13, tan L=117) and a shelf-edge line (row 14). There is no lighter horizontal top surface above the frame.
evidence: The top of the bookshelf is only a 1px dark outline (row 10) with the top compartment's back panel directly under it. The tan band at rows 11-13 is the interior back wall seen face-on, not a top surface, and it stays in the same tone family as the rest of the face. The shelf boards (rows 14, 22, 32, 41) are thin edge lines (1-2 rows of L=157 plus a dark shadow row), so they read as front-facing board edges and not as horizontal surfaces seen from above. The compartments are inset with dark inner edges, but the whole body is a flat architectural front elevation with no visible top. This matches the red 'front elevation: top 1' guide.

style.evidence: The wood ramp has about 5 steps (#411e05, #63310b, #6d3b15, #9e684b, #d59147). The outline is a tinted dark brown, with only 2% near-neutral dark edge pixels. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. The books, plant and bottle add varied colour and per-item detail. The median of 15 colours per tile is close to the references (17 and 20). Total distinct colours (18) is well below the references (38-40), but the piece is small and simple. It would sit acceptably next to the references without looking like a sticker.
